rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a physical object bounds or springs back after impact.

example.english: The ball will rebound after hitting the wall.
example.jyutping: go3 bo1 zong6 dou3 coeng4 zau6 wui5 faan2 daan6

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an object bouncing back and for a setback followed by a renewed upswing.

example.english: After falling for several days, the stock market finally had a rebound today.
example.traditional: 股市跌咗幾日，今日終於有反彈。
example.jyutping: gu2 si5 dit3 zo2 gei2 jat6 gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 faan2 daan6

rows.note: Use this when describing a cave, room, or other place that gives back an audible echo.

example.english: When you talk in this cave, your voice will rebound.
example.traditional: 呢個山洞入面講嘢，啲聲會有回音。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 saan1 dung6 jap6 min6 gong2 je5 di1 seng1 wui5 jau5 wui4 jam1

rows.note: Use this for a return to health or well-being after illness or another setback.

example.english: They made a quick rebound after their illness.
example.traditional: 佢病完之後復原得好快。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bing6 jyun4 zi1 hau6 fuk6 jyun4 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a new romantic relationship started to get over a previous breakup.

example.english: A rebound relationship started soon after a breakup may not last long.
example.traditional: 分手冇耐就開始一段療傷式戀愛，未必長久。
example.jyutping: fan1 sau2 mou5 noi2 zau6 hoi1 ci2 jat1 dyun6 liu4 soeng1 sik1 lyun2 oi3 mei6 bit1 coeng4 gau2
